name: balsalazide
inchikey: IPOKCKJONYRRHP-FMQUCBEESA-N (E-azo parent; product is the disodium salt; PubChem CID 54585 stores the connectivity block IPOKCKJONYRRHP-UHFFFAOYSA-N, same first block)
identity_state_after_p4b: verified by structure (ChEMBL and PubChem InChIKey first block agree)
role_in_p3: slot:overall_mimics; PPARG -> SLC2A1; Z total -3.30 / in-degree -3.03
decision_label_insufficient_support_vs_n: insufficient support at the declared target (not a statement that the compound is inactive)
decisive_datum: The declared main target PPARG belongs to the metabolite mesalamine, not to the dosed molecule: 0 of 678 balsalazide rows (complete) and 0 of 428 mesalamine rows are on PPARG; the cited primary work activates PPARG-driven reporter in HT-29 cells at 30 mM, whereas the label gives 5-ASA Cmax 0.22 ug/mL (about 1.4 uM) after 2.25 g fasting, a ratio of about 2e4
depth_of_evidence: MEDIUM (label and ChEMBL complete; the PPARG paper read at passage level; edge references read as titles)
feasibility: LOW (prodrug cleaved in the colon; parent urinary recovery 0.1-0.2 percent; no neural-cell protocol exists for the prodrug)
next_experiment: None recommended. If the PPARG-glycolysis edge is ever tested it should be done with a potent PPARG agonist in WWOX-deficient neural cells, not with balsalazide or 5-ASA.
exposure_and_nervous_system_summary: Label (openFDA, set 029833fa..., effective 2025-02-18): prodrug delivered intact to the colon; parent Cmax 0.51 ug/mL, 5-ASA 0.22 ug/mL, N-Ac-5-ASA 0.88 ug/mL (fasting, n=17); protein binding >=99 percent; paediatric use established 5-17 y for ulcerative colitis. No CSF or brain datum found.
safety_counter_evidence_summary: Label: seizures appear only under overdose (salicylate toxicity). PubMed 'balsalazide AND (seizure OR convulsion OR epilepsy)': 0 hits. openFDA spontaneous reports (counts only, no rate): 505 reports matched, seizure 5, convulsion 1, generalised tonic-clonic seizure 1. Neurodevelopmental toxicity: none found (absence of a search hit, not evidence of safety).
trials_registry_summary: ClinicalTrials.gov 2026-10-30: balsalazide 9 studies (ulcerative colitis, healthy volunteers); 0 with epilepsy, seizure, DEE, hypomyelination, neurodevelopmental disorder, intellectual disability or cerebral palsy.
target_expression_summary: PPARG: HPA adult brain snRNA low cell-type specificity, detected in many; WWOX-KO organoid bulk 1.8-4.9 CPM (4 KO, 2 WT); absent from the hNPC CAGE table. SLC2A1 (the seed): endothelial in adult brain snRNA.
limits_on_transfer_to_WWOX: One transcript seed (SLC2A1 up, two systems, one method, organoid n=4 v 2); PPARG hub; edge from peripheral cells; maturity confound stated in P1.
unverified: Exact PPARG potency of 5-ASA (no activity row exists; mM figure is one paper); brain/CSF 5-ASA concentration in children; SIRT5 relevance of the parent (IC50 3.9-5.3 uM, human recombinant, five documents) was not pursued.

name: ramelteon
identity_state_after_p4b: verified by structure (ChEMBL and PubChem CID 208902 by InChIKey)
decision_label_insufficient_support_vs_n: insufficient support (the compound is potent at its receptor; the proposal has no supporting record)
decisive_datum: The proposal is a three-edge chain built from a G-protein coupling assay, a GNAO1-overexpression result in glioma stem-like cells and a Hes1-null mouse skin transcriptome (no record measures receptor activation followed by a BNIP3 change), and the main target is not detected in the WWOX-deficient systems: MTNR1A 0.00-0.10 CPM and MTNR1B 0.00-0.10 CPM in 6 organoid libraries, neither gene in the hNPC CAGE table
depth_of_evidence: MEDIUM (ChEMBL complete 334 of 334, label, three edge abstracts, local expression)
feasibility: HIGH to run (approved oral drug, nanomolar) but without a target in the system
next_experiment: None recommended for the WWOX-derived proposal. Receptor-level neuroprotection by melatonin agonists is a separate literature, not derived from the WWOX seeds.
exposure_and_nervous_system_summary: Human MT1 Ki 0.014 nM and MT2 0.045-0.112 nM (CHO cells, two documents). Label: absolute oral bioavailability 1.8 percent, Tmax 0.75 h, half-life 1-2.6 h, metabolite M-II 20-100 fold the parent, protein binding about 82 percent; paediatric safety not established. Rat: brain 390 nM and plasma 580 nM at 1 h after 10 mg/kg i.p. (one time point, ChEMBL document CHEMBL1667823). No human CSF datum found.
safety_counter_evidence_summary: Rodent anticonvulsant effects (kindling, Kcna1-null mouse; kainate model); in Neuro-2a cells ramelteon blocks INa and IK(DR) with IC50 8.7 and 2.9 uM. Label: decreased testosterone and increased prolactin, effect on the reproductive axis in developing humans unknown. openFDA counts (no rate): 7,349 reports; seizure 61, convulsion 44, epilepsy 30, status epilepticus 5. No neurodevelopmental toxicity study found.
trials_registry_summary: ClinicalTrials.gov 2026-10-30: ramelteon 80 studies; 0 with epilepsy, seizure, DEE, hypomyelination, neurodevelopmental disorder, intellectual disability or cerebral palsy.
target_expression_summary: HPA adult: MTNR1A not detected in brain snRNA; MTNR1B 1.6-5.3 nCPM in inhibitory neurons, ependymal cells, medium spiny neurons. Organoid: both about 0 CPM. Seizure model literature reports induction of melatonin receptors in astrocytes (abstract).
limits_on_transfer_to_WWOX: BNIP3 is one transcript seed; mimics-direction (compound would raise BNIP3) so any effect would push toward the WWOX-loss pattern.
unverified: Which cell line the Cell 2019 coupling record used (title level); whether low receptor transcript is sensitivity-limited in bulk and snRNA data.

name: belzutifan
identity_state_after_p4b: verified by structure (ChEMBL and PubChem CID 117947097; synonyms PT2977, MK-6482)
role_in_p3: fill:new_mechanism_group; EPAS1->LDHA; opposes; Z total 3.51 / in-degree 3.06; conditional on uncertain seed
decision_label_insufficient_support_vs_n: insufficient support (the compound is a selective, potent HIF-2alpha inhibitor; whether its target operates in the WWOX-deficient neural cells is not known)
decisive_datum: Missing datum: HIF-2alpha (EPAS1) protein, stabilised and nuclear, in WWOX-deficient neural cells and its contribution to LDHA/SLC2A1 transcripts. Adult brain HPA places EPAS1 in vascular cells (endothelial, pericyte, smooth muscle), not neurons; organoid EPAS1 is 1.2-9.1 CPM; absent from the hNPC table; HIF-2alpha conditional knockout in mouse cortex did not change cortical development (abstract)
depth_of_evidence: MEDIUM (ChEMBL 238 of 238; DailyMed label read; HPA; local expression; edge titles)
feasibility: MEDIUM-HIGH in vitro (a go/no-go readout exists; research supply UNVERIFIED)
priority_of_next_experiment: MEDIUM-LOW (cheap, decisive about HIF-2alpha involvement, not a therapy path)
next_experiment: Go/no-go in WWOX-deficient hNPC/neuron/organoid systems and isogenic controls: (1) EPAS1 protein and nuclear localisation, normoxia and 1-3 percent O2; (2) only if detected, belzutifan concentration series bracketing its reported cell EC50 (11 nM in a reporter line) plus EPAS1 and HIF1A knock-down arms.
readout: LDHA, SLC2A1 and BNIP3 transcripts (qPCR/RNA-seq); HRE/ARNT reporter; extracellular lactate and 13C-glucose label into lactate versus TCA intermediates; valence readout: viability and neurite or network activity under normoxia and low O2, with the compound-by-genotype interaction as the test.
control: Vehicle; EPAS1 siRNA and HIF1A siRNA arms to separate the two isoforms; the same series in a wild-type line; an inactive structural analogue if one is obtainable (UNVERIFIED).
falsifier: No EPAS1 protein in the KO cells, or belzutifan at 10 times its cell EC50 changes LDHA/SLC2A1 by less than the between-replicate difference while EPAS1 knock-down also does not; either closes the HIF-2alpha path. The effect-size threshold must be written before the run.
exposure_and_nervous_system_summary: DailyMed label (set 13e15ee0..., version 13, effective 09/2026): median Tmax 1-2 h, Vd 119 L, protein binding 45 percent, half-life 14 h, urine 49.6 and faeces 51.7 percent of dose; paediatric use established only from 12 years for pheochromocytoma/paraganglioma; no CNS PK in the label; CNS hemangioblastomas are an indication (tumour response, not a CSF measure).
safety_counter_evidence_summary: Boxed warning: embryo-fetal toxicity; severe anaemia (haemoglobin decreased in 93 percent in the VHL study) and severe hypoxia warnings; dizziness 38 percent. The label text has no seizure or convulsion string. PubMed 'belzutifan AND (seizure OR convulsion OR epilepsy OR neurotoxicity)': 0 hits. openFDA counts (no rate): 618 reports, epilepsy 3. Anaemia and hypoxia in a child with a DEE is a mechanistic concern with no source for an effect on seizures (UNVERIFIED).
trials_registry_summary: ClinicalTrials.gov 2026-10-30: belzutifan 47 studies (MK-6482 33, PT2977 25 under the same compound); 0 in the neurological and neurodevelopmental conditions searched.
target_expression_summary: HPA adult brain snRNA: EPAS1 group-enriched in endothelial cells (1,673 nCPM), pericytes and vascular smooth muscle; ARNT broad. Organoid: EPAS1 KO/WT CPM ratio 3.8 (n=4 v 2, descriptive); HIF1A 0.84.
limits_on_transfer_to_WWOX: LDHA seed is up in both systems but falls with culture time in an unrelated spheroid series (maturity confound); LDHA is mainly a HIF-1alpha target; belzutifan acts only on HIF-2alpha/ARNT dimerisation and needs stabilised HIF-2alpha.
unverified: Research-use availability and price; whether any inactive analogue exists; EPAS1 protein level in the systems; ChEMBL transcription of the cited potency documents (not opened).

name: ceperognastat
identity_state_after_p4b: verified by structure across ChEMBL and PubChem (CID 135260636; PubChem synonyms include LY3372689; ChEMBL returns this same molecule for both names); the INN-to-structure assignment itself rests on those depositors and was not checked against the WHO INN list
decision_label_insufficient_support_vs_n: insufficient support for the proposal; the compound is a potent OGA inhibitor, and class safety counter-evidence is added
decisive_datum: The sole network edge OGA->PFKP is a protein-activity record (O-GlcNAcylation inhibits PFK1 enzyme activity in A549 cancer cells; sign obtained by inversion of OGT->PFKP) applied to a PFKP transcript seed (organoid KO/WT CPM ratio 1.00); OGA has only four outgoing edges, all O-GlcNAc-on-enzyme records, so no alternative path reaches a transcript
depth_of_evidence: MEDIUM (ChEMBL 1 of 1 row; 3 abstracts; passage-level full text of the edge paper)
feasibility: LOW (investigational, programme reported negative; research supply UNVERIFIED)
next_experiment: None recommended as a WWOX-derived proposal. O-GlcNAc homeostasis in brain development is a separate, independently motivated question (OGT-related intellectual disability models); it would need its own premise.
exposure_and_nervous_system_summary: OGA IC50 2.36 nM (human full-length enzyme, baculovirus, document CHEMBL5576136, 2024). CNS-penetrant: more than 95 percent OGA occupancy in human brain by PET in phase 1 (abstract); oral. Phase 1 studies in healthy adults (NCT03819270, NCT03944031, NCT04106206, NCT04392271, NCT05749848) and phase 2 in Alzheimer disease (NCT05063539). No paediatric datum.
safety_counter_evidence_summary: Phase 2 (JAMA 2026 abstract): 3 mg arm 32 percent greater progression than placebo, more serious and severe adverse events (serious 26.4 percent vs 15.7 percent placebo); class-wide synaptic plasticity suppression in mouse hippocampal slices for three OGA inhibitors including ceperognastat (J Prev Alzheimers Dis 2026 abstract); O-GlcNAc dyshomeostasis (OGT variant mouse) causes microcephaly, cortical dysplasia and hyperactivity (eLife 2026 abstract). Seizure-specific data: none found.
trials_registry_summary: ClinicalTrials.gov 2026-10-30: 'ceperognastat' 0 hits, 'LY3372689' 6 studies (5 phase 1 healthy, 1 phase 2 Alzheimer); 0 in the neurological and neurodevelopmental conditions searched.
target_expression_summary: OGA (MGEA5): broad in adult brain snRNA, low specificity; organoid 120-210 CPM; hNPC TPM 14.7 (hNSC). PFKP broad.
limits_on_transfer_to_WWOX: PFKP seed is a set member (GLYCOLYSIS_LACTATE_10, weight 1/sqrt n) and its single-gene value is flat in the organoid; transcript is not flux.
unverified: Programme status after the 2026 reports; research availability; the edge's primary study (Science 2012) was read at abstract level only.

depth_of_evidence: MEDIUM for the identity question (ChEMBL complete, HGNC and ChEMBL target records fetched)
next_experiment: No experiment. Keep as the documented symbol-collision control for the direct-search arm; add 'PDPK1 vs PDK1 (PDH kinase)' to the symbol-collision checks of any future direct search.

safety_counter_evidence_summary: No seizure or neurodevelopmental datum found (not searched beyond the title-level PubMed list, 69 hits). The compound inhibits AKT signalling in cells and has antifungal and antibacterial rows in ChEMBL (acetyl-CoA synthetase inhibition in fungi is in a 2026 paper title, not opened).
trials_registry_summary: ClinicalTrials.gov 2026-10-30: 'AR-12' 4 studies, of which 3 are false hits (a Holter monitor model AR12 and others); the one real study is NCT00978523; 'OSU-03012' 1 study (the same). The 'epilepsy / neurodevelopmental / intellectual disability / cerebral palsy' hit NCT03602378 is the Holter-model false hit.
target_expression_summary: PDPK1 broad in adult brain snRNA (low specificity); PDK1 (PDH kinase) low cell-type specificity; organoid PDPK1 52-77 CPM.
unverified: Whether AR-12 has untested activity on PDH kinases (no row exists: absent data, not a negative result).

role_in_p3: reference; PDK1 is both seed (uncertain direction) and target
decision_label_insufficient_support_vs_n: not applicable (comparator for the PDH-axis premise test)
decisive_datum: Edge/valence: the engine's recovery of dichloroacetate is RECOVERED_ONLY_VIA_OWN_TARGET: the Q2 seed PDK1 transcript has uncertain direction (lower in sign in organoid and hNPC; higher in neurons d14 and in a fibroblast PDK-family seed) and the compound acts on PDK protein activity, so under 'PDK1 transcript down' it mimics and under 'up' it opposes; the result carries no information beyond the seed itself
biological_promise_given_seed_link_and_t: not applicable (carried by the existing cards E03 and I01)

next_experiment: Reuse of the registered PDH-axis premise test. The discriminating readout for valence: PDH E1alpha phosphorylation and PDH activity, 13C-glucose label into TCA versus lactate, in WWOX-deficient neural cells with dichloroacetate and a second, nanomolar PDK inhibitor.
control: a nanomolar PDK inhibitor of different chemistry (IT9 P4a)
falsifier: a null with dichloroacetate alone is not read as absence of a PDK effect (IT8 P3)
exposure_and_nervous_system_summary: See the IT8 P3 and IT9 P4a records: PDK1-4 IC50 about 0.1-5 mM in same-document rows; no human plasma Cmax found; not extended here.
